record.context_brief: Schwartz class wavelets for integer expansive dilations
record.original_question:
Schwartz class is the collection of all ∞-regular functions on R^n. Let A be an expansive dilation with integer entries (equivalently AZ^n ⊂ Z^n) and let Γ = Z^n.

Do Schwartz class wavelets exist for integer expansive dilations A and lattice Γ = Z^n?

evidence.quote:
Problem 3.5. Do Schwartz class wavelets exist for integer expansive dilations A and lattice
Γ = Zn ?

3.5. Meyer wavelets for integer dilations. Schwartz class is defined as a collection of
all ∞-regular functions on Rn .

3.1. Known results. A typical assumption about a dilation A is that it is expansive or
expanding. That is, all of eigenvalues λ of A satisfy |λ| > 1. This is the class of dilations for
which most of the higher dimensional wavelet theory has been developed. In addition, it is
often assumed that a dilation A has integer entries, or equivalently
(3.2)                                         AZn ⊂ Zn .

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\ge 1$ and let $A$ be an $n\times n$ real matrix that is expansive (every eigenvalue $\lambda$ of $A$ satisfies $|\lambda|>1$) and has integer entries (equivalently, $A\mathbb{Z}^n\subset\mathbb{Z}^n$). Let $\Gamma=\mathbb{Z}^n$. A finite family $\Psi=\{\psi^1,\dots,\psi^L\}\subset L^2(\mathbb{R}^n)$ is called an orthonormal wavelet for the dilation $A$ and lattice $\Gamma$ if the system
$$\{|\det A|^{j/2}\,\psi^\ell(A^j x - k) : j\in\mathbb{Z},\ k\in\mathbb{Z}^n,\ \ell=1,\dots,L\}$$
is an orthonormal basis of $L^2(\mathbb{R}^n)$. The Schwartz class $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ is the collection of all $C^\infty$ functions on $\mathbb{R}^n$ all of whose derivatives decay faster than every polynomial.

Question: For every integer expansive dilation $A$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, does there exist an orthonormal wavelet $\Psi=\{\psi^1,\dots,\psi^L\}$ for $A$ and $\Gamma=\mathbb{Z}^n$ with each $\psi^\ell\in\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^n)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is known to be solved affirmatively in dimension $n\le 2$: for every expansive $2\times 2$ integer dilation, there exists an orthonormal wavelet consisting of $|\det A|-1$ band-limited Schwartz-class functions. Recent work (2025) extends Schwartz-class wavelet constructions to rational expansive dilations via MRA-based Meyer-type constructions. However, for general integer expansive dilations in dimensions $n\ge 3$, the existence of Schwartz-class wavelets remains open.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in Wavelet Theory (Bownik)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 3.5: Do Schwartz class wavelets exist for integer expansive dilations A and lattice Γ = Z^n? For every expansive 2×2 integer dilation, there exists a wavelet of (|det A|-1) band-limited Schwartz class functions; hence Problem 3.5 needs to be answered only in dimensions ≥ 3.
status_evidence.claim: Stated as an open problem; resolved positively in dimension 2, open in dimensions ≥3.

status_evidence.title: Meyer wavelets for rational dilations (arXiv:2501.17448)
status_evidence.snippet: For a rational n×n expansive dilation, there exists an orthonormal wavelet in the Schwartz class, associated with an MRA.
status_evidence.claim: Schwartz-class wavelets are constructed for rational (in particular integer) expansive dilations under MRA assumptions, providing partial progress.
